name: ALLIN1 Colored Smoke Grenades
summary: Seven independent M18-style smoke weapons showing a complete Enhanced Story Mode integration: metadata, ammo, animation, labels, HUD aliases, GBAY, runtime behavior, transactional archive writes, and save-bound persistence.

nodes.label: Seven custom weapon records
nodes.description: Cloned from WEAPON_SMOKEGRENADE, then assigned independent hashes, wheel slots, ammo pools, labels, and stat keys.

nodes.label: Independent five-round ammo pools
nodes.description: Each color is a native inventory type capped at five. Native smoke deployment is disabled so the runtime layer owns color and timing.

nodes.label: Throwable animation mappings
nodes.description: Every custom hash needs the stock smoke mapping in all six animation sets or equipping can produce a T-pose.

nodes.label: Native weapon-wheel labels
nodes.description: The seven GXT keys are merged into the current build's global.gxt2 rather than painted over the HUD by script.

nodes.label: BZ Gas weapon-wheel artwork aliases
nodes.description: Scaleform chooses weapon artwork by signed weapon hash. Both BZ Gas HUD timelines receive frame-label aliases for each custom hash; StatName does not control this icon.

nodes.label: Grounded colored-plume controller
nodes.description: Tracks the matching custom projectile, waits for a stable collision, removes the noisy rolling canister, then emits the selected color at the settled position.

fields.Persistence: Stage inventory changes in memory; commit only with the Story Mode save.

nodes.label: GBAY product and persistence integration
nodes.description: Seven separately purchasable five-packs with independent stock and native ammo counts.

fields.Persistence: Purchases and consumption become permanent only when the character saves the game.

fields.MergeStrategy: Clone current-build WEAPON_SMOKEGRENADE records and append validated definitions.
fields.Backup: Exact entry backup plus pre-merge update.rpf snapshot.

fields.MergeStrategy: Clone the stock mapping in every compatible set and change only its key.
fields.Backup: Exact entry backup plus pre-merge update.rpf snapshot.

fields.MergeStrategy: Open nested archive under its exact filename and append seven hashed GXT entries.
fields.Backup: Exact american_rel.rpf backup plus pre-merge update.rpf snapshot.

fields.MergeStrategy: Add only the seven FrameLabel tags beside each BZ Gas frame and prove stripping them reproduces the original bytes.
fields.Backup: Exact scaleform_generic.rpf backup plus pre-merge update.rpf snapshot.

fields.Registration: No add-on dlclist entry; uses verified base-archive merges.
fields.Safety: GTA must be closed; write exact backups first; validate merged bytes; rollback the full snapshot on failure.

references.description: Every weapon points at its same-color independent ammo pool.
Every weapon hash is present in all required throwable animation sets.
Every HumanNameHash resolves to a native GXT string.
Every signed weapon hash receives a BZ Gas artwork frame alias.
Every custom projectile is recognized by the colored-plume controller.
Every weapon is independently purchasable and save-backed in GBAY.

install_steps.title: Link weapon and ammo definitions
install_steps.description: Clone the installed stock smoke records, assign independent identifiers, and verify removing the additions reproduces the original XML.

install_steps.title: Link throwable animations
install_steps.description: Add 42 mappings: seven weapons across six animation sets.

install_steps.title: Link native wheel text
install_steps.description: Append seven GXT entries without replacing Rockstar text.

install_steps.title: Link BZ Gas wheel artwork
install_steps.description: Map each INT<signed hash> label to both BZ Gas artwork frames.

install_steps.title: Link grounded smoke behavior
install_steps.description: Deploy colored plumes after the thrown object settles and remove the rolling audio source.

install_steps.title: Link GBAY and save persistence
install_steps.target: GBAY weapon catalog and character inventory
install_steps.description: Expose separate five-packs and commit transactions only when Story Mode saves.

install_steps.title: Install transactionally
install_steps.strategy: exact backups, hash verification, snapshot rollback
install_steps.description: Refuse live-game writes, verify every installed entry, and restore the full snapshot on any failure.
